_comment: The workspace IS the marketplace AND a consumer of its own ai-team plugin - dogfooding per ADR-0015. Resolved via the GitHub source after the workspace was published to jaetill/agentic-dev-environment. For local development against an un-pushed local checkout, swap the source for {"source": "directory", "path": "<absolute>"}. The permissions block carries the canonical deny rules (plugin manifests cannot ship permissions per the Claude Code plugin spec).
